facts.text: The Stallion Free Tuition Grant covers the remaining tuition and mandatory fee balance for first-time freshmen or transfer students who qualify for the maximum Pell Grant.

sources.title: Tuition Free University for Low Income Promise Program Texas
sources.quote: What costs are covered by the Stallion Promise? The grant will cover the remaining balance of any tuition and mandatory fees not covered by other grants, scholarships, exemptions, benefits, and/or waiver programs received by the student.

sources.title: Tuition Free University for Low Income Promise Program Texas
sources.quote: To be considered for the Stallion Free Tuition Grant, eligible undergraduate students must meet all of the following requirements: First-time freshman or transfer student pursuing first undergraduate degree. Submit the latest FAFSA available by the University's priority financial aid deadline. Qualify for the maximum Pell Grant
